# Smart Checkout Widgets

> Smart Checkout Widgets is a Shopify checkout customizer for every plan: payment and shipping method rules (hide, rename, reorder, including hiding Cash on Delivery) and Thank You and Order Status page widgets on any Shopify plan, plus automatic gifts, customer-choice rewards, upsells and custom fields in checkout on Shopify Plus. It works with Shopify Sidekick, which can read its rules, gifts and widgets.

Payment and shipping rules and Thank You and Order Status widgets work on Basic, Shopify, Advanced and Plus. Widgets on the checkout page itself need Shopify Plus, because Shopify only allows checkout-page customization on Plus. Eight one-click templates cover the most common payment and shipping rules.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-14.

## Primary resources

- [Smart Checkout Widgets homepage](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/): Product overview, capabilities, plans, frequently asked questions, and installation path.
- [Documentation](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/docs/): How to configure widgets, checkout gifts, upsells, shipping and payment method rules, rule conditions, plan order limits, and troubleshooting.
- [Smart Checkout Widgets on the Shopify App Store](https://apps.shopify.com/smart-checkout-widgets): Public app listing and installation page.
- [Pricing and plan limits](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/pricing.md): Machine-readable details for Starter, Growth, and Advanced plans.
- [Shopify checkout gift apps comparison](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/compare/shopify-checkout-gift-apps/): Comparison criteria for evaluating Shopify checkout gifting apps.

## Core capabilities

- Automatic free gifts triggered by checkout thresholds.
- Customer-choice gift selection at checkout.
- Checkout upsells and BOGO or automatic discount campaigns.
- Trust badges, banners, accordions, custom fields, and payment icons.
- Payment method rules (hide, rename, reorder) with cart, customer, product, address and date conditions, on every Shopify plan.
- Shipping method rules with the same actions and conditions, scoped to shipping rates, local delivery, carrier pickup points, local pickup locations or retail.
- Thank You and Order Status page content widgets for all Shopify stores.

## Partner guides and app comparisons (October 2026)

Thought Bulb, which builds Smart Checkout Widgets, also makes Cart Rocket, TB Bundles and Agentmatica. The comparisons below were checked against each app's Shopify App Store listing or pricing page on 2026-10-14.

- [Cart Rocket: shareable cart and checkout links for Shopify campaigns](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/cartrocket-preloaded-cart-links-shopify/): Links that open the cart or checkout with discounts applied without a code, bundles at a set price, creator links and QR codes. $9 a month for one active link, $15 for unlimited, per its App Store listing.
- [TB Bundles: build-your-own boxes, quantity breaks and mix and match](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/tb-bundles-shopify-bundle-app/): Five bundle types, discounts enforced by Shopify Functions, real component SKUs in the cart. Free plan, then $12.99, $24.99 and $49.99 a month by bundle sales.
- [Agentmatica: an AI sales and support agent for your Shopify store](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/agentmatica-ai-sales-support-agent-shopify/): A web app (not a Shopify App Store app) that answers from site pages, files and the live catalog, builds carts and looks up orders. Free plan, then $29, $79 and $199 a month by replies.
- [Shopify cart link apps compared (2026)](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/compare/shopify-cart-link-apps/): Checkout Links, Cart Rocket, ZipLinks, CCL, UR: Simple Checkout Links and Cart Link Builder by Wonder, plus Shopify's free cart permalinks.
- [Shopify bundle apps compared (2026)](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/compare/shopify-bundle-apps/): Shopify Bundles, Bundler, Kaching, Fast Bundle, Simple Bundles & Kits, BOGOS and TB Bundles, by pricing model and bundle types.
- [AI chat and shopping assistant apps for Shopify compared (2026)](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/compare/shopify-ai-chat-apps/): Shopify Inbox, Agentmatica, Zipchat, Tidio, Gorgias, Rep AI, Manifest AI and Intercom Fin, by what each charges for.

## Merchant problem guides (October 2026)

- [How to customize Shopify checkout without Plus in 2026](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/customize-shopify-checkout-without-plus/): What Basic, Shopify and Advanced stores can change in checkout (branding, payment and shipping rules, gift discounts, Thank you page blocks, order editing) and what still needs Plus.
- [Let customers fix a wrong shipping address without a support ticket](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/customers-fix-wrong-shipping-address-shopify/): Customers correct the address on the Thank you and Order status pages within an edit window, with a fulfillment hold so nothing ships first. Same country and state only.
- [Shopify upgraded your Thank you page: what to check and what to add back](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-thank-you-page-upgrade-what-to-add/): After the August 2026 move of non-Plus stores to the new Thank you and Order status pages: what stopped working, what to check if sales dropped, and which blocks to add.
- [How to cut COD returns (RTO) on a Shopify store in India](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/reduce-cod-rto-shopify-india/): Hide cash on delivery by pincode, order value and customer history, put UPI first, and let buyers cancel before dispatch. The app does not add COD fees or partial prepayment.
- [Turn slow-moving stock into a free gift with purchase](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/free-gift-slow-moving-stock-shopify/): Use stock that won't sell as a threshold gift or a pick-your-gift offer, keep the margin in check, and read gift results on the Results page without over-reading them.

## Checkout rules and cart guides

- [How to hide, rename and reorder shipping methods in Shopify checkout](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/hide-rename-reorder-shipping-methods-shopify-checkout/): Rename vague shipping rates, hide couriers that do not fit the order, and put the option you want first, with rules that work on every Shopify plan.
- [How to hide cash on delivery in Shopify checkout by cart value, country or customer](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/hide-cash-on-delivery-shopify-checkout/): Cash on delivery drives refusals and return costs. Here is how to show it only where it makes sense, using payment method rules that run on any Shopify plan.
- [Ask Shopify Sidekick why a payment method is missing](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-sidekick-checkout-rules/): Sidekick can read your payment and shipping rules, gifts and widgets, and tell you which rule hides or renames a method.
- [Show real low-stock badges in Shopify checkout](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-checkout-low-stock-badge/): An "Only 3 left" badge under each checkout item, using your real inventory. How it works, what you can change, and when a low-stock note helps.
- [See what your checkout gifts and upsells earn](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-checkout-gift-upsell-results/): Gift and upsell orders, revenue and average order value from your own Shopify orders, on every plan, and how to read the gift comparison honestly.
- [Let customers edit their own Shopify orders](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-customer-order-editing/): Shopify has no self-serve order editing. How customers can change the address, swap a size, lower a quantity or cancel from the Thank you and Order status pages, on every Shopify plan.
- [Shopify is removing the Checkout Blocks branding editor on December 31, 2026: what to do](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/shopify-checkout-blocks-branding-editor-removal/): The Checkout Blocks branding editor goes away on December 31, 2026. What it controlled, who is affected, your three options, and a migration checklist to finish before Black Friday.
- [Smart Checkout Widgets vs Checkout Plus (2026): features, pricing and Shopify Plus requirements](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/compare/smart-checkout-widgets-vs-checkout-plus/): An honest comparison of Smart Checkout Widgets and Checkout Plus: every feature side by side, what each costs at your order volume, and when to choose each.
- [Free shipping progress bar in Shopify checkout: setup, thresholds and what to pair it with](https://smartcheckoutwidgets.com/blog/free-shipping-progress-bar-shopify-checkout/): A progress bar turns a shipping threshold into a goal the buyer can see. How to set one up in checkout, pick the threshold, and pair it with a gift.

## Plans

- **Starter:** Free; up to 100 orders per month.
- **Growth:** $29 per month or $278.40 per year; up to 1,000 orders per month.
- **Advanced:** $59 per month or $566.40 per year; unlimited orders.
- **Pro:** $99 per month or $950.40 per year; unlimited orders, plus customer order editing on every Shopify plan, and the stock urgency widget and checkout branding editor on Shopify Plus.
- Paid plans can limit a gift to specific customers. Each store gets one 7-day free trial of a paid plan.
